task: Deploy merged bounded streaming while preserving the existing preview browser-access policy and verify actual large page audits.
nonGoals: Scoring changes, paid usage, database or secret changes, unrelated resources, or CI deployment.

outcomes.description: The new streaming release preserves exact preview-origin CORS and current sitemap/guide retrieval.
outcomes.evidence: Registered CORS regressions and feasibility tests.

outcomes.description: An actual public preview submission reads a synthetic page beyond 512 KiB and reports partial findings without final score at the 1 MiB cap.
outcomes.evidence: Expiring synthetic fixture Worker, public preview browser checks, and private sanitized release record.

process.description: Commit plan first, obtain independent review and hosted CI, deploy the reviewed source manually with existing bindings preserved.
process.evidence: Git history, CI, review and release verification.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse previously reviewed browser policy and fixed synthetic fixtures without dependencies or new persistent resources.

exitTest.reason: Release compatibility and temporary validation fixtures do not change agent portability, workflow or resumability.
